name: DeFiSaver
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: One-stop asset management solution DeFiSaver tweeted that it experienced an attempted DNS attack and, according to its analysis, no users were affected. DeFi Saver said that what the DNS attack has in common with Convex Finance and Ribbon Finance is the domain name registration service Name cheap, reminding other projects to use it with caution.
